question: The famous male torso from Harappa, remarkable for its naturalistic pose and chiselled in the round, is made of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**red limestone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The famous male torso from Harappa is made of **red limestone**, showcasing the artistic prowess of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• This artifact is remarkable for its **naturalistic pose**, indicating advanced sculptural techniques used during the Harappan period.
 
• The sculpture is **chiselled in the round**, meaning it is a three-dimensional artwork that can be viewed from all sides.
 
• The male torso exemplifies the use of **red limestone**, a material commonly used for sculptures and artifacts in Harappan culture.
 
• This iconic artifact reflects the Harappans' emphasis on **realistic human representation**
